editorial_candidates.diagram_specification: Draw M=(F^N)^{tensor n} centrally, with the quantum action image A_F and normalized Hecke action image B_F mapping into End_F(M). Mark that the two images commute; show A_F=End_{B_F}(M) and B_F=End_{A_F}(M) for the matrix-algebra images. Add a side condition N>=n for faithfulness of the abstract Hecke action, and N<n for the explicit warning that the image equality does not assert abstract-Hecke faithfulness.
editorial_candidates.reason: The statement and [F1] give two commuting actions on one tensor space, mutual commutant equalities, and a separate faithfulness threshold; a compact algebra-action diagram could make those distinctions easier to scan. The prose and proof are complete, so this is optional and not a missing mathematical step.
